utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s at 3 over by the community center, and Bo’s bringing the repair kit to meet me there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ve got it noted and I’ll keep Nell posted on the update. Thanks for handling the meetup at 3 by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — 3 at the community center is still the plan, and I’ll meet Bo there with the repair kit.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along any updates I hear. Just let me know as soon as there’s news, and I’ll help spread it too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Nell — I’ll send Tess the latest details and a simple supply list soon. Cleo can help keep track of supplies, too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect — I’ll watch for Rosa’s updates and share them along. A simple supply list will help a lot, so send it when you can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep Oren’s screws, hammer, and duct tape on my list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring my cart and round up some tools too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll add your cart and tools to the list too. Thanks, Rey — that’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll bring the spare screws, a hammer, and some duct tape for the repair drive. Once I know the details, Faye can help coordinate around school pickup too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds helpful. I’ll check the details and make sure Jules knows to help connect folks and spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Hana — that should keep things moving. I’m still ready with the screws, hammer, and duct tape once you’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — send me the repair drive details when Oren has them, and let me know the location once Opal confirms it. I’m juggling school pickup, so that’ll help me keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll send the repair drive details once Oren has them and pass along the location when Opal confirms it. Hope school pickup goes smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — I appreciate it. I’ll wait for Oren’s details and Opal’s location update.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got the tools ready on my end—just let me know if Ira hears anything. And once Sam gets here, we can sort those donated parts together.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Rosa’s got it on the list already, so that part’s covered. If Rey’s free, he can help round up the tools and haul whatever we need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — if Rey can help round them up, I’ll keep the tools set aside and ready. Just tell me when you hear back from Ira.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll ask around while I’m out and let Eli know what I hear about the repair drive. Gus has the tools ready, so that part sounds set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira. Can you check the start time for me too?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll ask about the start time while I’m out and tell Eli what I find.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess—tell me the time, place, and what they still need, and I’ll keep it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep folks posted on the repair drive plan, including the time, place, and what they still need. I’ll make sure the word gets around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. I’m counting on the details to stay clear, and I’ll keep it on my calendar once Tess fills me in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll bring the hammer, screwdrivers, and a box of nails, and I can help sort the donated parts and line up the boxes too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sam — I’ll tell Eli the latest details about the repair drive and let him know you’re bringing the tools and helping with the boxes too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — thanks, Tess. I’ll see you at the repair drive and get the tools and boxes ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting the timing and drop-off details for the repair drive, but it’s just a few homes. Mina can map a simple route, and I’ll circle back once I’ve got it lined up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on, right? Just let me know the final timing and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still on. I’m pinning down the final timing and drop-off spot now, and I’ll let you know as soon as it’s settled.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and remind folks to bring small tools or any spare parts they’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’m checking the last few donations now. Sam’s lining up the boxes, and I can help sort and load once they’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I’ll keep spreading the word and remind everyone to bring small tools or spare parts. Just let me know when the boxes are ready and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yep, the repair drive still looks on track. I just wanted to check in quickly, and we can pick this back up later.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still at 3 at the community center. I’ll bring the repair kit.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks for bringing the repair kit. See you at 3 at the community center—we can catch up later if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Tess usually has the latest details, so I’m waiting to hear time, place, and what they need. I like to keep it clear and planned out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’ll spread the word and remind folks to bring small tools or spare parts. Once Tess shares the time and place, I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Dane. Once Tess has the time and place, let me know and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’m juggling school pickup, so I need the repair drive details first. Oren can send them over, and Opal can keep the location straight for me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s at 3 at the community center. I’ll bring the repair kit.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thank you — I’ve got 3 at the community center. I’ll keep moving around school pickup, and I’ll wait for Oren’s details too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m still sorting the donations, then I can help load the boxes. Sam’s got the boxes lined up already.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Nice, I’ve got the tools ready too—if Ira hears anything while out on errands, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if Ira says anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll bring the hammer, screwdrivers, and a box of nails, and I can line up the boxes too. Leo can sort the donations, and I’m happy to help with the donated parts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Sam — I’ve got the list updated, and I’ll make sure Nell has everything she needs. Thanks for helping keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Glad to help, Rosa. Just let me know if there’s anything else you need before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll double-check the details and let folks know Jules is happy to help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Hana. I’m glad the list is moving along — my window latch and faucet are still on there, so I appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Of course — I’ve got your window latch and faucet noted, and I’ll keep checking the list before I pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting together a quick repair drive, and I’d love your help keeping track of supplies. I’ll send over a simple list and the latest details for Tess, too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll keep track of the supplies for the repair drive. Oren’s bringing spare screws, a hammer, and duct tape, so I’ll note that down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks, Cleo — I’ll send the simple supply list and the latest details for Tess right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: The repair drive stops go in this order: first the community center, then Mrs. Alvarez’s house, and last the corner workshop. I’m just mapping the simplest route now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s a good simple route. I’ll work out the timing and drop-off details for Kira next.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Rey’s checking the start time for me, so once that’s set, I can finish the route.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve been asking around while I’m out running errands, and I’ll let Eli know if I hear anything useful about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — can you confirm the timing and drop-off details once Pia double-checks them?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I’ll check back with Pia and let Eli know the timing and drop-off details as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep the plan moving around the neighborhood and remind folks to bring small tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Vik — I’ll keep spreading the word too, and Dane can jump in wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll keep folks posted so the plan keeps getting around the neighborhood. If anything changes, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll bring the spare screws, a hammer, and some duct tape to the repair drive. Once we’ve got the details, Faye can help coordinate around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll take Eli the latest details about the repair drive. And with Faye coordinating around school pickup, we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks Tess — once Eli has the latest details, I’ll make sure my repair-drive stuff is packed and ready. I’m a bit forgetful, so I’m glad Faye’s on the school pickup coordination too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yep, I just checked and the repair drive details are still on track. We can pick this back up later—no rush.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—I'll round up some tools and bring my cart for hauling materials when we're ready.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks, Rey—your cart will help a lot. We’ll pick it up later and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is at the community center at 3, and Bo is bringing the repair kit to meet me there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’ll keep an ear out and pass along any updates I hear. Rosa said she’ll keep things clear and let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Nell — that helps. I’ll be at the community center at 3 for the repair drive and Bo’s bringing the kit.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
